text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 22, 2025) for 204 Kingston Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel deferred consideration of the Appeal for 204 Kingston Road - Appeal of Property Standards Order - Folder Number: 25 197324 PRS 00 IV until the December 8, 2025, meeting of the Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel, to allow the parties to submit additional evidence.
